Frequently Asked Questions

Is the gold rate different in different states of India?

No - the IBJA publishes one national gold rate. The 22K rate is the same in Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, and every other city in India on any given day.

Why do prices at local jewellers seem different?

Local jewellers add their own margin above the IBJA rate - this can vary by city or even by shop. The IBJA benchmark itself is national.

Does Tamil Nadu have a different gold rate from Karnataka?

No - same national rate. Any difference you observe between shops is the buyer/seller margin, not a state-level rate variation.

Why does Dubai gold seem cheaper than Indian gold?

Dubai does not levy customs duty on gold in the same way India does. India's 15% import duty makes domestic prices higher than Dubai prices.

Do making charges differ between states?

Yes - making charges vary between jewellers and states. Karnataka jewellers may charge different making charges from Tamil Nadu jewellers. But the underlying gold rate (IBJA) is the same.

Where can I verify the national gold rate?

ibja.co - the official IBJA website. The same rate applies nationwide.

Does the gold rate differ in rural vs urban areas?

No - the IBJA rate is the same. Rural jewellers may have slightly wider margins but the benchmark is national.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I sell gold using only a PAN card without Aadhaar?

No - Aadhaar is mandatory for all gold sales at certified buyers in India. PAN alone is not sufficient. Aadhaar is the required primary KYC document.

Why is Aadhaar mandatory for gold sales?

RBI and PMLA guidelines require Aadhaar-based KYC for high-value asset transactions. Gold sales are covered under these guidelines.

What if I don't have Aadhaar?

Apply for Aadhaar at your nearest UIDAI enrolment centre. In the interim, some buyers may accept other OVDs (Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence) - but Aadhaar is the standard.

Does PAN replace Aadhaar?

No - PAN is required IN ADDITION to Aadhaar if the sale exceeds ₹2,00,000. PAN does not replace Aadhaar.

Can I use my driving licence instead of Aadhaar?

Only Aadhaar is the standard for gold sales under the current KYC framework. Other OVDs may be accepted in exceptional cases - call the branch to confirm before visiting.

What if my Aadhaar is expired?

Aadhaar cards do not expire - they are valid indefinitely. If the number is active in UIDAI records, the card is valid regardless of when it was issued.

Can I use e-Aadhaar downloaded from UIDAI?

Yes - e-Aadhaar (from uidai.gov.in) and the mAadhaar app are officially recognised alternatives to the physical card.

Key Facts

  • Does KDM gold still exist?...
  • Does KDM gold pay less when you sell?...

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between 22K hallmark and 22K KDM gold?

Hallmarked 22K gold has been independently tested and certified by a BIS-approved centre (minimum 91.6% gold). KDM gold was manufactured using cadmium solder - it may be 22K in the main body but the solder areas contain cadmium and may test lower overall.

Does KDM gold still exist?

KDM solder was banned by BIS around 2001. Old KDM pieces still exist in circulation (heirlooms, inherited jewellery) but no new KDM gold is legally made.

Does KDM gold pay less when you sell?

If the XRF test shows lower-than-22K average purity due to KDM solder, yes - you receive the rate for the tested purity. This is common for pieces repaired with KDM before 2001.

How do I know if my gold is KDM?

Old gold without a BIS hallmark is often KDM-era. XRF testing will show cadmium (Cd) in the elemental breakdown if KDM solder was used.

Is KDM gold less valuable?

Only if the XRF shows lower average purity. The gold body may be 22K, but solder-diluted areas test lower.

Why was KDM banned?

Cadmium is toxic and was used as a low-cost joining agent. BIS banned it on health and purity integrity grounds.

Yes - all gold including older KDM-era pieces are accepted. XRF testing determines the actual purity and you are paid accordingly.
